text:
Nora (CS): flagging inbound tickets  several EU onboarding customers reporting higher-than-normal errors during embeddings ingest and fallback to a secondary reranker since ~09:12 UTC.
Eli (CS): rough size? any paying enterprise in the list?
Marco (Eng): preliminary: ~4% of onboarding traffic. one canary pod group hit sustained memory growth, triggering fallback routing. no data lost but increased latency/backlog for affected tenants.
Pri (SRE): raised INC-2026-3011 and started a canary rollback; monitoring in progress.
Nora (CS): need a short, customer-safe message we can paste into tickets and the onboarding queue. keep it clear about ETA and reassure no data loss. Eli please draft.
Eli (CS): draft: ```Hi there  were aware of intermittent ingestion failures affecting a subset of EU onboarding flows. Our engineers are rolling back a canary and monitoring recovery. Your documents are safe and will be indexed once systems stabilize. We expect normal processing within ~30 minutes and will send a full RCA within 24 hours. Apologies for the disruption.```
Marco (Eng): tweak: call out that rerank fallback may temporarily reduce result quality for live preview; add that canary is disabled until patch lands.
Eli (CS): updated.
Nora (CS): perfect. Ill send to impacted list and DM the top-5 enterprise onboarders with an offer for a dedicated reindex and a goodwill credit. Eli  paste the quick troubleshooting steps for support replies.
Eli (CS): troubleshooting snippet: ```If you see errors: 1) Retry ingestion after 10 minutes; 2) Include request-id when contacting support; 3) If backlog hasnt cleared in 60 minutes, reply here and we will queue a manual reindex.```
Pri (SRE): rollback completed at 09:28 UTC; error rate dropping. PagerBot: INC-2026-3011 update: rollback executed by Pri at 09:28 UTC; severity -> partial, recovery observed.
Marco (Eng): will leave the canary disabled and add a tokenization edge-case test to the canary test suite. patch ETA to QA ~3 hours.
Nora (CS): follow-ups: 1) initial note sent (done); 2) personalized outreach to top-5 (Nora); 3) approval flow for credits (Eli); 4) RCA + timeline in 24h (Marco). scheduling a 14:00 CET office hour for impacted customers.
Eli (CS): logging any replies here. if an impacted customer requests immediate reindex, tag @ingest-ops.
Marco (Eng): RCA summary for CS: memory growth in rerank worker triggered by a rare tokenization pattern in long documents; mitigation = rollback + patch; next steps = add improved observability for memory and extend canary coverage.
Nora (CS): thanks all  closing for now, reopen if customers report ongoing issues. :white_check_mark:
